ModMetaData.name: Giddy-Up Editor
ModMetaData.author: EvilEyeGuy
ModMetaData.description:
An in-game editor for Giddy-Up 2. Fix how riders sit on their mounts and how the overlays are placed, live and without restarting.
Open it with development mode on: select an animal and click the mount editor button.
Rider - Four previews, one per direction, with the rider on the animal. - Move the rider per direction, mirror east and west. - Put a test rider on any animal to check it.
Animal - Make any animal rideable or not rideable. - Draw the animal in front of the rider when it faces south.
Overlay - Move the front, side and back overlay, separately for male and female if needed, scale it or turn it off. - Draw your own mask for the south view with a lasso: set corner points along the outline, for example along a mane, move, insert and delete points, use several areas. The mask shows on the animal right away.
All settings and masks are kept in the RimWorld config folder and are applied on every start. Nothing in Giddy-Up or other mods is changed. The settings can be exported as a patch file for use in your own mod.
Fixes a Giddy-Up issue where every animal used the overlay offsets of the first animal drawn with an overlay.
